name: swingle
description: Brings the model freedom of open harnesses to Claude Code and Codex: delegate a job to any provider CLI already installed on your machine (codex, claude, opencode, grok, pi, agy, omp), with advisory model preferences, provider notes, contracts, and an auditable ledger. No proxy, no key custody.

interface.shortDescription: Bring open-harness model freedom to Claude Code and Codex
interface.longDescription: Claude Code and Codex only expose their own provider's models. Swingle backports the model freedom that open harnesses like opencode already have: it drives whichever provider CLI is already installed and authenticated on your machine (codex, claude, opencode, grok, pi, agy, omp), using advisory model preferences, provider notes, reusable contracts, and an auditable ledger. Everything runs locally against credentials you already hold, with no proxy and no key custody.
